item.title: 'We're still here,' Hanukkah event increases security following Bondi Beach terror attack
item.description: LAKEWOOD RANCH, Fla (WFLA) — The mass shooting in Australia is weighing on those here at home who are celebrating Hanukkah. item.title: Americans like artificial Christmas trees even though few are made in US and prices are up
